text:
jordan: Heads up — CI microbench on PR #13088 failed the kvcache warmup / hit-rate threshold in the shadow run. Failing test: benchmarks/kvcache_warmup_test. Diff shows ~-3% kv-hit and +6% tail token latency.

ci-bot: [CI] benchmark threshold check failed on pr-13088 (runner: perf-ci-12). See artifact: https://ci.internal/reports/pr-13088/kvcache_warmup.

mira: Ugh. That PR touched the prefetch window + eviction heuristics, right? Which commit landed in the merge?

sam: It looks like commit 9f4c2a7 bumped PREFETCH_WINDOW from 32->48 and changed the eviction scoring to favor older keys. Bisect across last merge window points at 9f4c2a7 -> 3f6dacc as the regression start.

anya: Can we get a quick trace of KV warmup hits by seqlen? If prefetch window increased then cold-path miss rate early in seq could be higher for short sequences.

jordan: Pasting the top of the benchmark log (trimmed):

```
bench/kvcache_warmup_test: runs=1000
median_lat: 2.8ms -> 2.98ms (+0.18)
p99_lat: 12.4ms -> 13.1ms (+0.7)
kv_hit_rate: 0.874 -> 0.849 (-0.025)
seqlen_hist: short(1-16): hit 0.82 -> 0.77
                 med(17-64): hit 0.90 -> 0.88
                 long(65+): hit 0.95 -> 0.95
```

mira: That pattern smells like over-prefetching pushing out hot short-prefix entries during warmup. Prefetching more entries but not evicting correctly for short traces.

sam: Agreed. Quick mitigation: revert the PREFETCH_WINDOW bump in the PR and re-run. If that fixes, we can iterate a smaller window or adaptive window based on recent seqlen.

ci-bot: [CI] re-run queued: pr-13088 (perf-ci-12) by jordan — priority: high.

anya: Also request to add KVCACHE_DEBUG=1 artifact collection on the benchmark job so we get per-step hit-map. Add a small perf-test flag to the job instead of full debug to keep runtime sane.

jordan: Filed follow-up: https://issues.internal/RED-2042 "kvcache warmup regression on pr-13088 — collect hitmap and try PREFETCH_WINDOW revert". Reverting now and will push a revert commit to the branch.

mira: If revert fixes it we should add a guarded rollout: prefetched entries only when average seqlen > 24 or when global hitrate > 90% to avoid harming short-seq workloads. Add an AB test via rollout policy.

sam: I'll prepare a quick patch with adaptive window and a unit test for short sequence hit-rate so this doesn't regress again.

jordan: Thanks — will follow up with result from rerun. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: [CI] rerun finished: pr-13088 (perf-ci-12) — revert-9f4c2a7 applied -> benchmark PASS (kv_hit_rate 0.873). Rolling back original change until we have adaptive strategy.

mira: Nice. Marking PR as rollback-blocked until a safer prefetch strategy is implemented.

anya: Putting a tiny perf unit (kvcache_short_seq_regression) into the golden suite before merge to catch this pattern.

jordan: Closing loop: revert confirmed, follow-ups assigned (sam: adaptive window + test, anya: golden test, mira: rollout policy)."
